summary: Direct typed tool calls are admitted again: the before_tool_call guard now accepts the provider's Responses call id `call_<hex>|fc_<hex>` (the `|` was outside its id alphabet). Since sfar-amine/samantha-core#476 makes the frequent samantha_* tools direct-only, the brain calls them directly with that id, and every call was refused as capability_first_required. The deploy parcours now also fails a reply saying a tool is « momentanément indisponible ».
reason: S24 30/10 22:57 UTC: deploying dbe0f455 (#476) was rolled back by the deploy parcours (write_recap failed). The S24 transcript shows samantha_agenda called directly with the Responses id and refused by the guard; Samantha answered « l’accès Agenda est momentanément indisponible », and owner_read passed by mistake on that sentence. No event was written (agenda checked).
